name: bounded two-object transfer certificate checker
material_outcome: PASS iff an immutable root-to-root transition is a consistent single transfer preserving total A+B and binding both object events to the same stable op_id.
inputs: A event named by next root
B event named by next root

checks.property: A_event.prev_event and B_event.prev_event equal previous.object_heads A/B
A_event.before and B_event.before equal previous.state A/B
A_event.after and B_event.after equal next.state A/B
A_event.op_id equals B_event.op_id, is present in next.applied_op_ids, and is absent from previous.applied_op_ids
delta_A + delta_B equals 0 and both deltas are nonzero with opposite signs

decision_rule: PASS iff T1-T8 all pass; otherwise FAIL with exact ids.
scope: Two-object integer transfer semantics only. This is proof-carrying state validation, not arbitrary dynamic execution.
zero_dependency_note: All predicates are finite text/integer comparisons over connector-readable immutable objects; no hosted build runner, external compute service, paid quota or manual user step is needed.
